header: What a control network costs when nobody maintains it
lead: Every district has a set of fixed points that everybody measures against and nobody owns. Ulrike Traxler has spent six years working out what happens to survey work when those points quietly drift — and what the re-measurement costs when it can no longer be put off. Forty minutes, with the numbers from three districts including this one.
author: Ulrike Traxler
role: Professor of geodesy, Technische Hochschule Sandau
